The season will begin on 5 September 2026 and will end on 2 May 2027. There are 12 teams competing this season. The winning and runner-up teams will gain promotion to the [[Kategoria Superiore|2027–28 Kategoria Superiore]], along with the play-off winners. The promotion play-offs final's loser will play a promotion play-off match against the 9th ranked team of the [[2026–27 Kategoria Superiore]]. {{Cite
